name: ACCT 3260
title: Federal Income Taxes
description: (Also offered as BADM 3260.) A study of the underlying concepts of federal income taxation. Emphasis to be placed upon the impact of taxes on business decisions.
requirement_description: ACCT 3201 or BADM 3201; open only to business majors of junior or higher status. May not be taken out of sequence after passing ACCT 4261.
